author: Antonialock
body: GO:0010468 | regulation of gene expression from ARBA00028334: this annotation is based on annotation to pombe proteins cid12, cid13,cid14,cid16, cid1 this comes from e.g. cid12: annotated to silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin formation (has parent regulation of gene expression) cid13: annotated to 3'-UTR-mediated mRNA stabilization (has parent regulation of gene expression) cid14: priRNA 3'-end processing (has parent regulation of gene expression) cid16: nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening (has parent regulation of gene expression) cid1: negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA poly(A) tail shortening and polyuridylation-dependent decapping of nuclear-transcribed mRNA (has parent regulation of gene expression) meanwhile, cid11 is annotated to RNA 3'-end processing, which has parent "gene expression", which might be incosistent? is this an ontology issue rather than an arba issue? ARBA00026480 will disappear since GO:0010605 | negative regulation of macromolecule metabolic process is now do_not_annotate (will remove 11,358 annotations)
